envelope.definition: archived empirical endpoint envelope, reproduced bitwise on all 8 archived cases: span = max(range(last 100), range(previous 100)); drift = |fsum(last 100)/100 - fsum(previous 100)/100|; two_printed_quanta = 2*10**(floor(log10(max |v| over the last 200)) - 9); envelope = span + drift + two_printed_quanta; passed = envelope <= 1e-8. An empirical settling indicator, not a rigorous error bound. Range of the older window alone and quanta from the older window also fit the archive; the conservative maximum is used. A window whose values are all exactly zero has zero printed quanta (not in the archive).

reconstruction_check.budget_definition: one 10-significant-digit print quantum of the native value (twice its maximal print rounding) plus the documented accumulation budget of pressure_loads
